post.message: Orange freckles on the bottom corners of your garage door? In Miami, sprinklers, afternoon storms and salty air all give steel a head start. Most of it is just a light dusting on a hinge or track edge. Rust on a spring or cable is a different story, and that one is for a pro, not a DIY fix. Take a flashlight on a ten-minute walk-around and see which kind you have.
